stories.title: Breslow: Surging Red Sox deserved big trades
stories.summary: The Red Sox acquired three-time All-Star catcher Adley Rutschman in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, the biggest in a slew of deadline moves for Boston.

stories.title: Tigers president defends return in Skubal trade
stories.summary: Tigers president Scott Harris dismissed the idea that Detroit should've waited right up until the deadline to trade Tarik Skubal, saying, "That's not how markets for the top players work."

stories.title: Source: Yanks to call up top prospect Lombard
stories.summary: The Yankees plan on calling up top prospect George Lombard Jr. on Tuesday after optioning shortstop Anthony Volpe to Triple-A, a source said.
